presets.name: 5v5 Standard
presets.script: A ban, B ban, A ban, B ban, A pick, B pick x2, A pick x2, B pick x2, A pick x2, B pick
presets.notes: Two bans each, then a snake pick order: 1-2-2-2-2-1. Five picks a side. A team picking twice in a row does both in one turn: they choose two heroes and lock them in together, on a single clock.

presets.name: 3v3 Standard
presets.script: A ban, B ban, A ban, B ban, A pick, B pick x2, A pick x2, B pick
presets.notes: The 5v5 order with the pick snake cut short at three a side: two bans each, then 1-2-2-1. Team A picks first, team B picks last. A team picking twice in a row does both in one turn, on a single clock.
